remarks: Welcome to the perfect canvas for your dream home! This ranch-style residence offers the convenience of one-level living in a sought-after cul-de-sac location. Whether you are a first-time homebuyer, an investor, or looking for a renovation project, this property provides the space and structural character to create something truly special. The heart of the home features a cozy living room characterized by a vaulted ceiling and exposed beams. The functional kitchen includes an eating area and provides ample cabinet and counter space, perfect for culinary preparation and casual dining. For those needing extra flexibility, the family room-complete with a cozy wood stove-can easily serve as a fourth bedroom or a private primary suite, as it includes a full bathroom and convenient laundry access.
